Interface ServerRequestBinderRegistry

All Superinterfaces:
ArgumentBinderRegistry<HttpRequest<?>>, RequestBinderRegistry
All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultServerRequestBinderRegistry, NettyServerRequestBinderRegistry
@Internal public interface ServerRequestBinderRegistry extends RequestBinderRegistry
The RequestBinderRegistry a server binds the arguments of its routes with, e.g. with the binders of the form fields of its requests. The request filter methods of the server filters bind their arguments with it too, like the routes.
